artworks.title: After the Hounds
artworks.dimensions:
image: 293 x 209 mm
primary sheet:  405 x 293 mm
secondary sheet: 447 x 321 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman riding a horse, calmly sitting upright in the saddle. She has delicate features, a focused expression, and neatly tied-back hair hidden under a riding hat. She wears a dark riding outfit with a high-collar jacket and gloves. She holds the reins, guiding the horse. A hound runs beside them in a rural landscape with barren trees and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The One Hoss Shay
artworks.dimensions:
image:180 x 320 mm
sheet:  325 x 446 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a side view of a horse-drawn carriage. A man is seated on the cart pulled by a horse along a dirt path. In the background, a horizon with a line of trees or bushes is visible against a softly shaded sky. The artwork is detailed and executed in an etched style, utilizing fine lines and cross-hatching techniques to depict textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. Closest to us, there are intricate line drawings of flowers and grass, and a tree on the right side extends its branches above the carriage.

artworks.title: Untitled (Harbor Scene with Sailboats)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 302 x 548 mm
sheet:  359 x 561 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with a level perspective. The horizon is positioned in the upper third, with a misty line adding depth. Sailboats, some with unfurled sails, are dispersed on the water. One boat stands out on the right with light sails. The technique is fine with smooth lines and gradations, resembling etching. The color scheme is primarily monochromatic with gray tones. Boat reflections on the water enhance the calm atmosphere. The boats decrease in size towards the distance, creating a sense of space.

artworks.title: Going to Market
artworks.dimensions:
image: 274 x 508 mm
sheet:  490 x 641 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper part of the image, sloping with hills, trees, and a dirt road winding across the scene. A horse-drawn carriage crosses a small bridge carrying two people with an umbrella. The style resembles an engraving with intricate lines detailing trees and foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic in black, gray, and white. A house is partially hidden by trees, and one figure is walking on the road.

artworks.title: The Breakers
artworks.dimensions:
image: 286 x 447 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  450 x 641 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a tumultuous sea under a cloudy sky. The horizon is high, emphasizing the ocean waves. A ship is sailing in the distance. The artwork uses swirling lines to depict the waves and sea texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and sepia. The sky blends with the waves in the distance, while closer waves appear sharp. The sea dominates the scene, highlighting its vastness compared to the ship.

artworks.title: Young Anglers
artworks.dimensions:
image: 294 x 460 mm
sheet: 483 x 540 mm
plate:  376 x 527 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a dock scene viewed from an eye-level perspective. Children and a dog are on a wooden pier over water. A boy holds a fishing rod, and another child leans over the dock. Boats are in the distance with their masts showing above the horizon. The water is calm with subtle reflections and boat hull outlines. The artwork uses an etching technique, with detailed and textured brushstrokes creating a soft monochrome palette. Tonal variation gives the piece a serene quality, emphasizing the tranquil water setting.

artworks.title: Quebec
artworks.medium: etching in black in wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with moored boats and a distant coastline. The horizon is low, above the water where buildings on the far shore are visible. Several boats, some with sails, are near a wooden dock, with a man in a small boat on the water. The artwork features detailed linework suggestive of etching or drypoint techniques, highlighting texture and detail on the boats and wooden structure. The color scheme is monochromatic in sepia tones. In the background, a townscape with buildings and ship masts can be seen through mist, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: An Evening Walk
artworks.dimensions:
image: 448 x 371 mm
sheet:  579 x 442 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with tall tree trunks closely spaced together. The horizon is hidden by more trees, and two figures stand among them. The figures appear silhouetted against a bright light source coming from behind. The art style features textured brushwork with fine strokes, creating an impressionistic look. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black, gray, and white. In the foreground, there is a small reflective pool of water mirroring tree branches. The background is dense with more trees, enveloping the figures in seclusion.

artworks.title: Untitled (River Scene with Boat)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil body of water with a horizon line above the center. Clusters of bushes and a sailboat with its reflection are visible. The brushstrokes are soft and impressionistic, with lines suggesting textures. The color palette consists mainly of brown and beige. Close to us, textured ground leads to the water's edge with organic forms suggesting plant life. In the distance, the landscape stretches toward the horizon in a serene stillness.

artworks.title: Connecticut River
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside scene. A dock extends into the water on the left side, with a sailboat moored in the distance. Further back is a village with buildings and trees, mirrored on the calm river surface. The sky is expansive with fine, delicate lines. The etching style features precise, thin lines and a monochromatic color palette of gray and sepia.

artworks.title: Untitled (Landscape with Fisherman)

artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path winding through a wooded area towards a river. In the upper third of the image, a structure is visible in the distance surrounded by greenery. The brushstroke technique is etching, creating detailed textures and patterns in the foliage and trees. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown. A figure stands near the water, providing scale to the scene, with detailed vegetation in the foreground creating a natural setting.

artworks.title: 78 Cross Street, Boston, Massachusetts
artworks.dimensions:
image: 227 x 108 mm
sheet:  279 x 159 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a building on a street corner. The horizon is low in the scene, with rooftops in the distance and a cobblestone path leading away from the viewer. The artwork is precise and includes fine lines to depict the building's facade and the cobblestones. The color scheme is sepia-toned. A sign displaying "McLaughlin Carpenter" hangs from the side of the building. The windows are intricately detailed with crosshatching. Another building is visible in the distance and birds are drawn in the sky.

artworks.title: Untitled (Alleyway with View of a Harbor)

artworks.description: The image features a narrow alleyway leading towards a harbor scene. A sailing ship is visible in the sea towards the center, framed by buildings. The artistic style consists of detailed etching strokes with a monochromatic color palette of browns. The alley is lined with stone and wooden structures, with a bucket and broom visible on the right. A sign saying "SAIL LOFT" is seen in the distance.

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a village scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A dirt road is lined with cottages, and the horizon is marked by rooftops and distant trees. The etching technique is used with fine lines to create texture in the thatched roofs and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of beige and brown. The road leads past cottages with chimneys and brickwork, and in the distance, there are trees and another cottage. The sky above is clear and takes up a significant part of the composition.

On the right side, a small dark house is seen near the riverbank amidst the trees. The etching technique is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, emphasizing textures of trees and water ripples. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with various gray shades creating a soft atmosphere. Closest to us, there is a rocky riverbank with sparse vegetation, while dense trees frame the distance. The image evokes a tranquil and contemplative mood.
